paras: In Bloodhoof Village, Maur Raincaller watches over Mulgore’s herds and wild beasts. He attends to concerns tied to the plains’ natural and spiritual life.

Maur Raincaller lives near the heart of Bloodhoof Village, on the shore of Lake Stonebull. He watches over matters involving Mulgore’s wildlife and the balance of the elements. After the strider Mazzranache bites him and infects his wound, Maur asks young travelers to gather animal parts for a remedy.
